text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0830 CDT.

CANOLA - C$1.00 to C$2.00 a tonne lower on lower CBOT soycomplex calls and good growing weather with concerns on lack of moisture limiting losses. Technical resistance seen at C$402 in the July. July WCE futures crush margin rose to -3.96 Friday from -5.22 Thursday. Canada's dollar was down at C$1.3860 against the U.S. dollar, and fell to 81.11 yen and 1.2349 marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 a tonne down on lack of hedges and spill over pressure from allied markets.

WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.30 to C$0.80 down on C$5 to C$6 a tonne cash premiums offered by southern Alberta feedlots due to a shortage of supply and weekend rain in Saskatchewan weighing on values. Oversold signals on technical charts should limit losses.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.50 to C$1.00 down on U.S. corn and wheat calls.
FEED PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 down on soymeal calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
